info.name: BuildFlow API
info.description:
BuildFlow /api/v1 endpoints. Run requests top to bottom inside a folder — several requests auto-fill the collection variables (token, project_id, task_id, supervisor_id) used by the ones after them, via each request's Tests tab script.

Start order: Auth > Login, then Projects > List Assigned Projects, then anything in Tasks.
